description: This Kotlin source file defines the NodeRuntime class, which manages app state, gateway connections, chat, voice, and device features for the OpenClaw Android app. It includes session management, connectivity logic, event handling, and user interface state updates.

classes.name: NodeRuntime
classes.description: Main class managing app runtime, including connections, sessions, chat, voice, and device states. It orchestrates gateway communications, handles events, manages UI states, and provides API for app features.

classes.name: NodeRuntime.GatewayTrustPrompt
classes.description: Data class representing a prompt shown to trust a gateway's TLS fingerprint.

classes.name: GatewayAgentSummary

classes.name: HomeCanvasPayload
classes.description: Serializable payload describing the state of the home canvas, including gateway status and agent info.

classes.name: HomeCanvasAgentCard
classes.description: Serializable info card for a home canvas agent, with id, name, badge, caption, and active status.
